findings.summary: cited ruff log is a stale red run and does not support the manifest's clean-ruff claim
findings.text: the ruff receipt cited in the manifest (test_logs) records 'check EXIT=1' and 'format EXIT=1' at rev c6ad9b332, the state before the style commit 9de1b2aff; the manifest's claim of clean ruff is true at head dc14f3d10 (verified independently) but the cited log does not support it, so a reader checking the receipt sees a failure where the record claims none.

item_verdicts.call_sites: reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:415 (materialize_committed_tree), reckon/crew/follower_registration.py:34 (follower_code_stamp), reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:428 (source_code_stamp), reckon/flight.py:263 (model_catalogue_path, the consumer of the carried file).
item_verdicts.diff: read the three commits c6ad9b332, 9de1b2aff and dc14f3d10 against base 3592c8f7c; they add CATALOGUE_RELATIVE_PATH, _mktree, _committed_catalogue_blob and _reload_tree_with_catalogue in reckon/checkout_trust.py, a 190-line test file, and the landing fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: tests/test_a_reload_image_carries_the_model_catalogue.py asserts declared_model_aliases includes the alias, model_cell_width == len(ALIAS), the composed agent record names the model and alias, and the identity moves on a catalogue-only commit and not on an outside commit; the manifest records that run and its result.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to make a reload image carry the model catalogue from the same revision so reloaded processes read model aliases and models; reckon/checkout_trust.py:334 (_committed_reload_tree) now folds docs/state/reckon/model-catalogue.yaml into the reload tree via _reload_tree_with_catalogue, so the image resolves it at the path reckon/flight.py:263 reads.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports 2 focused tests passed at rev c6ad9b332, regression arms 99/99 and 109/109 at base and head, and cites logs whose negative control ends EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/checkout_trust.py, tests/test_a_reload_image_carries_the_model_catalogue.py, the evidence fragment and the figures dir; every path in the diff is inside them (the figures dir is unused).

justifications.durability: the negative control at logs/negative-control.log reinstates the pre-change tree with no catalogue and the added assertions fail on it, so a regression reddens the test.
justifications.evidence: the gate measures the done_when, but the cited logs/ruff.log:52 records format EXIT=1 at c6ad9b332 while the manifest claims ruff clean (verified clean independently at head dc14f3d10).
justifications.fit: the change follows the surrounding subprocess/git idiom of reckon/checkout_trust.py:238 and its names carry no plan or ticket id.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/checkout_trust.py:334 folds the catalogue into the reload tree so the file lands at the path reckon/flight.py:263 resolves, and the test reads the alias back with the image's own package.
justifications.reuse: _mktree extracts the pre-existing inline mktree call in _committed_reload_tree and _reload_tree_with_catalogue extends that same owner; a search of reckon/ found no other mechanism that folds a path into a reload tree.
justifications.scope_discipline: all three changed paths (reckon/checkout_trust.py, tests/test_a_reload_image_carries_the_model_catalogue.py, the evidence fragment) are inside the declared write paths.
